Treat downloaded payloads as untrusted and verify integrity; a valid hash proves correspondence to metadata, not that the content is benign or legally authorized.

fields.label: Description
fields.value: Bots connect to a central service and receive relayed commands; centralization simplifies control but creates disruption points.

fields.label: Steps
value: A bot checks in with a configured control service.
The service relays authorized-by-operator commands to connected bots.
Bots perform assigned activity and may report status.
Defenders can investigate and disrupt central infrastructure through appropriate legal and technical processes.
